title: image-size: ICNS parser allows denial of service through an infinite loop
reason: No patched release exists (advisory range is "<=2.0.2", i.e. every published image-size version including the latest). appdmg is a build-time-only, darwin-only DMG packager invoked only by `npm run package:dmg`; it is never bundled into the shipped Electron app. Acceptance is scoped to this exact path (package.consumedBy) so the same advisory reached through any other, unaccepted dependency path still fails the gate.
